Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Gets Take-Private Offer From CVC, Japanese Firm
Kobayashi Pharmaceutical has received a joint proposal from CVC Capital Partners and Tokyo-based private-equity firm Nippon Sangyo Suishin Kiko to take the company private.

The Japanese healthcare company said Friday that it had received a preliminary, non-binding proposal regarding a potential take-private transaction from entities affiliated with CVC and the Japanese firm.
Kobayashi said no decision had been made by the company at this time.
